{{Youmay|the animal|the [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]] [[Blizzard 1/Legends|''Blizzard 1'']], also known as "Dune Cow"|linebreak=1}}
A '''dune-cow''' was a type of [[Sentience/Legends|animal]]. During the secret development of the [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]] [[Walker/Legends|walker]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zaloriis/Legends|Zaloriis]], a story circulated about a [[Zalorian/Legends|Zalorian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who had reportedly encountered a wheezing fifty-[[Foot/Legends|foot]] dune-cow with giant [[Tooth/Legends|tusks]] and a [[Color/Legends|gray]] [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] hide. The tale amused an Imperial [[Spy/Legends|counter-intelligence]] network, and the AT-AT [[Blizzard 1/Legends|prototype]] at [[Camp Culroon]] on Zaloriis was rechristened as the "Dune Cow."<ref name="GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The dune-cow was first mentioned in the DataBank entry for Zaloriis in the [[2001]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''.<ref name="GB" />
